structured_output.title: New ClusterIssuer short name is additive and optional
structured_output.content: The change only adds the `ciss` short name for the `ClusterIssuer` resource, so `kubectl get ciss` becomes available. The manifests show only `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` and no ClusterIssuer, and the values keys set include nothing related to short names. The evidence does not say that any existing name or behavior is removed or altered. The installed CRD list shows only certificates.cert-manager.io, so ClusterIssuer's presence in the cluster is not confirmed. Even so, the change appears to need no action.
